correctness.rationale: Positive-drift Dyck periodic points are in shift-equivariant bijection with words on M labelled opening symbols and one generic closing symbol, with height d determined by composition. Counting yields F_n(d)=binom(n,(n-d)/2)M^((n+d)/2); least period divides n and scales height under repetition, giving the stated Mobius sum over k|gcd(n,d). For odd n,d=1 the repetition correction is empty; for even n,d=2 only k=2 can subtract, and it appears iff n/2 is odd. A Chernoff upper bound for nonpositive heights and n(M+1)^(n/2) nonprimitive points, Stirling's central binomial formula, and the binomial CLT yield the displayed rare-shell prefactors and Gaussian limit. Independently enumerated primitive full-shift words for M=2,3, n<=8, agreeing with exact formulas; the finite check is not the proof.
